value.assessment: Consent is not demonstrated by this evidence. No valid, purpose-specific consent mechanism was resolved. The only consent-related artifact is a cookie banner: window.cookieconsent.initialise at frontend/src/index.html:19. The graph contains no configuration showing whether it is opt-in or merely informational, and no linked purposes, grants, consent records, or enforcement points. The privacy-policy notices (component file path redacted as «SECRET», lines 18-165) are not linked to any purpose (purpose_ids empty). They rely on implied consent, such as 'By using the Service, you agree to the collection and use of information,' and 'Your consent to this Privacy Policy followed by your submission... represents your agreement.' Implied consent by continued use does not meet an explicit-consent standard. No withdrawal paths, consent records, operations, or processor propagation were resolved, so there is no evidence that consent can be withdrawn or that it flows to processors. The GDPR erasure notice in views/dataErasureForm.hbs:32 states that users can request erasure. That is a notice only: no deletion operation was resolved, and a dispatched deletion would not by itself establish actual deletion. Child consent is 'not determinable.' No age or DOB collection and no verifiable parental consent mechanism were found. The policy's statement that it does not knowingly collect data from under-18s is a disclaimer, not an age gate, and it mentions 'verification of parental consent' without any mechanism behind it. Per the evidence limitations, absent links are not proof of absence, so these findings mean 'not resolved in the analyzed graph' rather than confirmed non-existence.
